text:
claire: Quick follow-up on the morning outage cluster (cloud control-plane spikes + model-registry 401s). Need owners + short timelines. I'll open a ticket after.
nate: I'll take model-registry auth. Root cause looked like failed token refresh during a KMS rotation. Short-term: add cached-token fallback + alert on refresh errors. ETA 4d.
ivy: I'll own provider routing fallback and provider engagement. Short-term: add region preference fallback policy. ETA 3d to ship policy + canary.
claire: Ops ask: add a preventative control to each checklist item (one line) and tag alerts with external_dep=true.
ops-bot: Created ticket EDRW-199: https://redwood.internal/incidents/EDRW-199. Owners add checklist items.
nate: Prometheus alert I'll add:
alert: ModelRegistryTokenRefreshErrors
expr: increase(model_registry_token_refresh_failures[10m]) > 0
for: 5m
labels: severity=high

ivy: Routing policy example (will refine in PR): {"route":"generation","fallback":["gcp-europe-west1","aws-us-east-1"],"circuit_breaker":{"threshold":0.05}}

claire: Sample checklist lines to paste to EDRW-199:
- [ ] nate — cached-token fallback + alerting — ETA 4d — preventative: pre-rotation canary
- [ ] ivy — routing fallback policy + canary — ETA 3d — preventative: prefer regions with low recent control-plane errors
- [ ] infra — KMS rotation audit — ETA 7d (assign infra)

nate: Claimed, starting branch now. Will post PR link to ticket when ready.
ivy: I'll canary the routing change at 5% then 25% if green.
ops-bot: EDRW-199 updated. Weekly ops sync review scheduled.
claire: Thanks — closing thread. Update ticket with PRs and runbook edits before the sync. :thumbsup:
